title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Release v1.1.8 (Unified Series Batch Dubbing Folder & Auto-Consolidation Pro)
release_notes:
• 📁 Unified Series Batch Dubbing Folder: Fixed episode separation issue where multiple folders were created per episode (e.g. EP001, EP002). All episodes now neatly export together into 1 unified series folder (e.g. D:/SN_Dramas/<Series_Name>/)!
• 🔄 Auto-Consolidation Engine: Automatically moves previously scattered episode video files into the unified drama series directory and cleans up empty folders on disk!
• 🎯 Intelligent Series Name Extraction: Accurately identifies genuine drama series titles across all episode naming schemes (_EP001, -ep01, .E05, 第01集, _01) without collision!
• ⚡ Continuous Performance & Stability Improvements.
